whatAContractIs: The middle-end stream's frozen scope, gate and rulings. The specification is the only authority; this file records what the stream is allowed to change and what it must measure.
scope: S1 randomized semantic gate: deterministic generator of validator-clean EvoIR, differential interpretation of original versus scalar-optimized module under an explicit budget, EVP1 replay through evo-proofcheck for every trial, shrinker to a minimal reproducer. Gate: 1000 programs in the workspace test with 0 mismatches and 0 refusals; 20,000 in the ignored long run.

S1a producer binding: each rewrite binding is computed from the recorded node children (11.3), pinned by the reduced reproducer test; the seeds 1592591013 and the eleven long-run seeds replay with status 0.

S1b zero-region claim: the checker compares after.evo with the canonical rendering of the parsed before.evo (11.3); the producer emits that rendering when it admits no region; pinned by the one-instruction gapped module.
S1c fuel: E3008 is counted on its own, never as undefined behaviour (10.4).

S2 coverage and record: (S2a) extend the generator to pointers crossing block edges, data-dependent but bounded loops, copy, lifetime.end, ptr.null, func_addr with indirect calls, and multiple ordinary returns, each pinned by the coverage assertion, and re-run the 1000 and 20,000 campaigns; (S2b) the evp2 certificate version of 11.3: budget line, epoch markers, and the checker verification of 8.11 (consumed within bound, epoch markers within the declared count, stop reason consistent), with evp1 still readable. RED first for both; every campaign number from a command.

S2b restated under 1.9.36: emit evp2 with the budget line and epoch markers; the checker verifies the six properties of 11.3 Budget; evp1 stays readable and verified; the randomized gate replays evp2; a hand-written certificate for each of the six properties in its failing form is refused with status 3 and in its holding form accepted.

S2c bounded scheduler: (1) measure whether the scalar sweep is a fixpoint by re-running it on every optimized module of the 1000-program campaign and counting admitted regions; if any, the record says policy, not saturated; (2) implement the multi-epoch bounded scheduler of 8.11 (epochs until saturation or a ceiling, fuel per rule per epoch, nodes counted over the persistent graph), deterministic for a given input and budget, with truthful stop reasons; the campaigns replay with epoch markers increasing inside a block and at least one hand-constructed input that stops at each of the three ceilings; (3) the shrinker gains the merge-block-into-unique-predecessor reduction.

S2d exhaustion and telemetry: (1) the producer records saturated when its last epoch fired nothing and policy otherwise, from the scheduler's own counters; (2) on any exhaustion the certificate keeps every region admitted before the stop and the checker verifies it like any other; pinned by a test with a budget the test itself sets on the producer's own stop rule (not the profile ceilings, which stay recorded as the box); (3) the campaign table gains the residual-region count (fresh transaction over each optimized module) as a standing metric; (4) no other change.

S2e runs and coverage: (1) the run of 8.11: chain up to max_transactions = 8 transactions, stop when one admits no region, verify each certificate alone and the chain by input/output digests; the campaign reports transactions per run and residual regions after the last, which must be 0 for every run that stopped before the ceiling; (2) generator coverage: recursion (bounded by a depth argument), pointers as call arguments and return values (in-bounds by construction), copy between two distinct objects (disjoint by construction), and a shape that makes signed_shl_defined true so ub.assume.invalid_signed_left_shift is emitted; each pinned by the coverage assertion; both campaigns re-run.
gate: cargo test --workspace; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --all -- --check; the 1000-program gate green; both reproducer tests green; wall time of the 1000-program test reported as the median of three runs on an idle machine.

rulings.schedulerRecordIsNotAGap: 2026-09-02: the executor reported that 8.11 requires budget and epoch lines while 11.3 makes them optional. The Versions paragraph of 11.3 settles it: evp1 carries no budget line, no epoch markers and no premises, and a checker validates it without a scheduler claim; evp2 adds the three. Every certificate produced today is evp1 and is valid. The bounded-scheduler record is the evp2 stage, not a defect.
rulings.checkerIsRightProducerIsWrong: 2026-09-02: 12 refusals in 21,000 trials, 0 semantic mismatches. Seven of eight reduced refusals are one producer defect (bindings taken from remapped operands); the eighth is the zero-region renumbering. The checker refused correctly in every case, which is the property the standalone checker exists to have.
rulings.fuelIsAHostLimit: 2026-09-02: E3008 allocated; a fuel-exhausted trial is neither undefined behaviour nor a comparison. The executor's separate counter was the right choice and is now the rule.
rulings.stageS1Closed: 2026-09-03: the randomized semantic gate is closed on branch head eaf7c6b, fast-forwarded into main. 21,000 programs: 0 semantic mismatches, 0 certificate refusals, all 27 scalar rules reached, the twelve formerly refusing seeds pinned as a replay test. The architect's isolated gate: 1133/0, clippy 0, fmt clean. Not covered yet and recorded by the executor: pointers across block edges, data-dependent loop bounds, copy, lifetime.end, ptr.null, func_addr and indirect calls, multiple returns, recursion, floating point and vectors; the shrinker lacks block merging.
rulings.budgetLineDefined: 2026-09-03: both S2b gaps were real. Every budget quantity is consumed/bound in that order; fuel is written consumed/bound with n declared, bound = max(256, 8*n), consumed = the most firings of one rule in one epoch; the checker verifies bounds equal the profile constants, consumed within bound, the fuel derivation, epoch markers within the consumed count, and stop-reason consistency; saturated and no-new-best are telemetry. Recorded in 11.3 with an example line.
rulings.aliasRightHandSideFromBinding: 2026-09-03: seed 1592636988 (extended shapes) refused because the alias right-hand side was read from the instruction's operand while 11.3 admits class:cI only for a bare variable bound to cI. Fixed by taking the right-hand side from the binding and choosing a deterministic representative (seeds in manifest order, then nodes in emission order). The checker was right for the thirteenth time.
rulings.stageS2aClosed: 2026-09-03: generator coverage extended to pointers across block edges, data-dependent bounded loops, copy, lifetime.end, ptr.null, func_addr with indirect calls and multiple returns, each pinned by the coverage assertion; 21,000 programs on the extended shapes: 0 semantic mismatches, 0 certificate refusals after the alias fix (seed 1592636988 pinned), all 27 scalar rules reached. Architect's isolated gate on b4af227: 1137/0, clippy 0, fmt clean; fast-forwarded into main. Still uncovered by the executor's own list: signed left shift assumptions, recursion, floating point, vectors, pointers as call arguments or returns, ordered pointer comparison, copy across distinct objects, block-merging in the shrinker.
rulings.epochMarkersFromOne: 2026-09-03: both S2b gaps ruled. Epoch markers are 1-based, k <= consumed epochs is tight, marker 0 is malformed; evp2 must carry the budget line and evp1 must not. The executor's implementation already matched both readings; the spec now says so.
rulings.saturatedMeansFixpoint: 2026-09-03: the scalar bridge is a single sweep and records stop=saturated. A single sweep is a fixpoint only if re-running it on its own output admits no region; that has not been measured. Until it is, a producer that stops by its own rule records stop=policy (new telemetry reason); claiming saturated without a fixpoint is a false record even though unverifiable.
rulings.stageS2bClosed: 2026-09-03: evp2 is produced and verified: budget line from real counters, epoch markers, the six checker properties each pinned by a one-field edit of a real certificate in refusing and holding form, evp1 still read, evp1 with any addition and evp2 without its budget line malformed. 21,000 programs replay evp2 with 0 mismatches and 0 refusals. Architect's isolated gate on 6c18d64: 1147/0, clippy 0, fmt clean; fast-forwarded into main. Open by the executor's own list: no premise or Tier B rule exists yet, every transaction is one epoch, no produced certificate has reached a ceiling.
rulings.saturatedIsTheTransactionsOwnFixpoint: 2026-09-03: the executor's SPEC_GAP was right and the architect's 1.9.37 sentence was wrong: saturated means no rule fired in the last epoch (8.11), not that a fresh transaction admits nothing. The residual-region count (1 program in 1000, 1 region, seed 1592591027) is the price of 11.6's before-witness rule for const_like and becomes a standing campaign metric. n is the largest region's starting count; stop=fuel is reserved for larger regions; a ceiling stop keeps admitted regions.
rulings.stageS2cClosed: 2026-09-03: bounded multi-epoch scheduler of 8.11 in place: a rewrite belongs to the epoch after the last one that changed a class it matches on, fuel per (rule, epoch), markers increase inside region blocks; 722 of 977 optimized programs run more than one epoch, deepest 6; wall time unchanged within spread (18.097 s). Fixpoint measured: 1 residual region in 1000 programs (seed 1592591027), a registry boundary of 11.6, which corrected the architect's saturation ruling. Shrinker merges a block into its unique predecessor (12 blocks to 5 on a generated module; no pinned reproducer shrinks, all are single-block). The three ceiling stops are verified only on hand-edited certificates because no P0 input can reach a ceiling. Architect's isolated gate on 04833ab: 1153/0, clippy 0, fmt clean; fast-forwarded into main.
rulings.keptRegionsAreProducerConformance: 2026-09-03: the executor observed that 'a ceiling stop keeps every admitted region' cannot be checked, because 11.2 permits a producer to decline any eligible region. Agreed: it is producer conformance, pinned by a producer-side test, in the same class as saturated and no-new-best.
